title: Brazilian Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew from Brazil that combines the richness of hazelnuts with tender beef. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sear the beef until browned, then set aside.
Saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chopped hazelnuts and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and add the potatoes.
Simmer for 1.5 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
